meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages. Use when the target is a syntax pattern (every call/class/import shaped like X, a codemod, a YAML rule) rather than literal text; for plain strings, comments, or filenames, use rg.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按代码的语法结构搜索并批量重写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在大量文件里按语法结构统一改代码
copy.tagline_en: Search and rewrite code by its syntax structure, at scale
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to edit code by syntax pattern across many files

howto.what: Claude 会用 ast-grep 按代码的结构形状(而不是文字)在 25 种语言里搜索和改写代码。改写默认先给预览,确认后才真正改动文件。
howto.when: 当目标是代码形状而非文字——形如 X 的调用、类、import 等——时接管,codemod 和 YAML 规则扫描也走它。查纯字符串、注释或文件名时改用 rg。

say.text: 找出所有接收 Request 参数的函数
say.note: 只列出匹配位置,不改动文件

say.text: 扫描项目里的 YAML 规则并列出违规项
say.note: 运行 sg scan,按规则报告违规

howto.what_en: Claude searches and rewrites code by AST shape (not text) across 25 languages. Rewrites default to a dry-run preview, and files are only changed after you confirm.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the target is code shape — calls, classes, imports, codemods, or YAML rule scans — rather than literal text. For plain strings, comments, or filenames, use rg instead.

say_en.text: Find every function that takes a Request parameter
say_en.note: Lists matches only; doesn't change files

say_en.text: Rewrite console.log to logger.info in src/, show a preview first
Run the YAML rules and list the violations
say_en.note: Runs sg scan and reports rule violations
